en_title: Elden Ring Players Are Hoping for Godwyn DLC After FromSoftware Shares Cryptic Social Media Post
cn_title: From Software神秘帖引《艾尔登法环》新DLC猜测
subtitle: 暗示还是巧合

paragraphs.en: It's been two years since FromSoftware released its Shadow of the Erdtree expansion, but a new post from the developer has some fans believing that even more Elden Ring DLC is on the way.
paragraphs.cn: From Software两年前推出《黄金树幽影》扩展内容后，如今开发商的一则新帖让部分粉丝相信，更多《艾尔登法环》DLC正在路上。

paragraphs.en: Outside of a few updates for multiplayer spinoff Nightreign and A24's live-action movie , things have been quiet over in the Elden Ring camp. So, when the studio behind the critically acclaimed fantasy RPG franchise published a somewhat ambiguous social media post , fans wasted no time going rabid with excitement.
paragraphs.cn: 除了多人衍生作《艾尔登法环：黑夜君临》的几次更新以及A24的真人电影外，《艾尔登法环》这边一直颇为沉寂。因此，当这家备受好评的奇幻RPG系列背后的工作室发布一则略显含糊的社媒帖后，粉丝立刻兴奋得近乎疯狂。

paragraphs.en: "Even the perilous hunt for the demigods holds moments of quiet wonder," the X/Twitter post said, accompanying a 12-second video of a player riding through Siofra River.
paragraphs.cn: X上的帖文配着一段12秒视频，画面中玩家骑乘坐骑穿过希芙拉河；帖文写道：「即使是危机四伏的半神狩猎，也有静谧奇观的时刻。」

paragraphs.en: Even the perilous hunt for the demigods holds moments of quiet wonder. #ELDENRING pic.twitter.com/5sJyVOYi17
paragraphs.cn: 即使是危机四伏的半神狩猎，也有静谧奇观的时刻。#ELDENRING（配图：https://pic.twitter.com/5sJyVOYi17）

paragraphs.en: It's innocuous enough on its own, but for those who have waited years for more Elden Ring DLC, it's turned into a gold mine to spin theories off of. The post itself has racked up 4.3 million views and 16K likes, with its replies filled with those who believe FromSoftware is trying to very, very subtly tell players that something is coming.
paragraphs.cn: 这则帖文本身看似无害，但对等待更多《艾尔登法环》DLC多年的玩家而言，它已经成了滋生各种理论的金矿。帖子本身已获得430万次观看和16K（1.6万）次点赞，评论区满是相信From Software正试图极其、极其含蓄地暗示「有事要来了」的人。

paragraphs.en: "GODWYN DLC?????" one popular quote post said .
paragraphs.cn: 一则热门转帖写道：「葛德文DLC？？？？？」

paragraphs.en: "I am delusional please give me a second expansion," another said .
paragraphs.cn: 另一人写道：「我肯定是妄想了，求你们给我第二个扩展内容。」

paragraphs.en: It's true that this post is a bit different from the studio's usual activity. The Elden Ring social media feed has been known to be either very direct, sharing things like announcements for updates, or extremely vague. Even then, it's hard to find a post quite like the one that has fans riled up, with few similar messages throughout 2025, if at all.
paragraphs.cn: 确实，这则帖子与工作室平时的动态略有不同。《艾尔登法环》的社媒动态通常要么非常直接，例如发布更新公告；要么极度含糊。即便如此，也很难找到这样一则让粉丝躁动的帖子：2025年里，即使有相似的信息，也少之又少。

paragraphs.cn: >葛德文DLC？？？？？https://t.co/h8qZ6OU4Da

paragraphs.en: The video being set in Siofra River and the lack of giant crab and Ancestral Follower enemies also have players on edge for more Elden Ring DLC. Unfortunately, there is very little reason to believe another expansion is on the way, at least for right now.
paragraphs.cn: 视频设在希芙拉河，加上画面中不见巨型螃蟹和祖灵之民敌人，也让玩家对更多《艾尔登法环》DLC更坐立不安。遗憾的是，至少眼下几乎没有理由相信另一部扩展内容正在路上。

paragraphs.en: Besides the post itself mostly seeming to highlight one of Elden Ring's many standout moments, there are plenty of other things it could be building hype toward. The team behind the Elden Ring movie announced they had wrapped filming earlier this week ahead of its March 3, 2028, release date . Our money, however, is on the Tarnished Edition that is set to come to Nintendo Switch 2 in just a few weeks .
paragraphs.cn: 除了这则帖子似乎主要只是在突出《艾尔登法环》众多亮点时刻之一，它还可能是在为许多其他事情预热。本周早些时候，《艾尔登法环》电影的制作团队宣布已杀青，计划于2028年3月3日上映。不过我们认为，最可能指向的是将在几周后登陆Nintendo Switch 2的《褪色者版》。

paragraphs.en: FromSoftware is no doubt interested in pushing fans to check it and its new content out, even if it is insubstantial compared to something like Shadow of the Erdtree. Some fans have also pointed out that the video seems to feature one of Torrent's new skins, which will also be available on other platforms in the near future.
paragraphs.cn: From Software显然希望促使粉丝关注《褪色者版》及其新内容，即便这些内容同《黄金树幽影》之类的作品相比显得单薄。也有粉丝指出，视频中似乎出现了托雷特的新皮肤之一；这些皮肤不久后也会登陆其他平台。

paragraphs.en: I JUST REALIZED THAT'S ONE OF THE NEW TORRENT SKINS IN THE VIDEO https://t.co/h8qZ6OU4Da pic.twitter.com/dOJ4JPp5LP
paragraphs.cn: 我刚意识到，视频里那是托雷特的新皮肤之一！https://t.co/h8qZ6OU4Da https://pic.twitter.com/dOJ4JPp5LP

paragraphs.en: The only thing Elden Ring fans know they can look forward to in the next month is the Tarnished Edition, but that isn't stopping fans from showing up in droves to plead with FromSoftware to release another DLC expansion. There are also those showing up in the replies section to call for more content for Nightreign, while those hoping for base game DLC argue they'd rather FromSoftware return to the game that started the franchise back in 2022.
paragraphs.cn: 未来一个月，《艾尔登法环》粉丝唯一确定能期待的事情是《褪色者版》，但这仍未能阻止粉丝蜂拥而至，请求From Software推出另一款DLC扩展内容。还有人涌入评论区，呼吁为《艾尔登法环：黑夜君临》提供更多内容；而期待本体DLC的人则认为，他们宁愿From Software回归这款在2022年开启这一系列的游戏。

paragraphs.en: Then, of course, there are the Bloodborne fans. Poor things.
paragraphs.cn: 当然，还有《血源诅咒》粉丝。可怜的人们。

paragraphs.en: For now, FromSoftware has not confirmed a second major DLC expansion for Elden Ring. We do know that the studio has some things in development , but outside of previously announced projects like The Duskbloods , much of its future remains a mystery.
paragraphs.cn: 目前，From Software尚未确认将为《艾尔登法环》推出第二个大型DLC扩展内容。我们确实知道该工作室有一些项目在开发中，但除《The Duskbloods》等先前公布的项目外，它的多数未来计划仍是谜。

paragraphs.en: IGN called Elden Ring a "Masterpiece" in our original 10/10 review . The Shadow of the Erdtree DLC earned the same rating .
paragraphs.cn: IGN在最初的10/10评测中称《艾尔登法环》为「杰作」。《黄金树幽影》DLC也获得了相同评分。

opus_summary: From Software发布《艾尔登法环》希芙拉河视频，引发玩家猜测葛德文DLC。官方未确认又一大型扩展，近期确定内容是将登陆Nintendo Switch 2的《褪色者版》。
